```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

source("R/data.R")
source("R/viz.R")
source("R/network.R")
d <- seec_read_data()
net <- seec_network(d)

updated <- with_tz(Sys.time(), "Africa/Johannesburg")

nodes <- net$nodes %>%
  mutate(id = row_number() - 1L)
id_of <- setNames(nodes$id, nodes$name)
edges <- net$edges %>%
  mutate(from = unname(id_of[from]), to = unname(id_of[to]))

role_counts <- table(nodes$role)
cross_dept <- net$edges %>%
  filter(type == "Supervision") %>%
  left_join(nodes %>% select(name, d_from = department), by = c("from" = "name")) %>%
  group_by(to) %>%
  summarise(both = all(c("Statistical Sciences", "Biological Sciences") %in% d_from), .groups = "drop")

payload <- list(
  nodes = nodes %>%
    transmute(id, name, role = as.character(role), department,
              department_raw = coalesce(department_raw, department),
              degree_group, degrees, community, links,
              n_students, n_papers, n_grants,
              staff = role %in% c("Leadership team", "Core", "Affiliate", "Postdoc")),
  edges = edges %>% select(from, to, type, weight, detail),
  levels = list(
    role = levels(nodes$role),
    department = c("Statistical Sciences", "Biological Sciences", "Other", "Not recorded", "Outside SEEC"),
    community = c(sort(setdiff(unique(nodes$community), "Smaller clusters")), "Smaller clusters"),
    degree_group = c("Doctorate", "Masters", "Coursework Masters", "Honours", "Unknown", "Staff and collaborators")
  )
)
```

::: last-updated
Last updated `r format(updated, "%d %B %Y, %H:%M %Z")`
:::

::: lead-text
How SEEC people are connected through supervision, co-authored papers and shared grants. Click a person to see their connections, drag to rearrange, and scroll to zoom. Use **Group by** to colour people by role, department, cluster or degree.
:::

```{r}
stat_row(
  stat_tile("People on the map", nrow(nodes),
            paste(sum(nodes$role != "Other collaborator"), "in SEEC records")),
  stat_tile("Connections", nrow(edges),
            paste(sum(edges$type == "Supervision"), "supervision ·",
                  sum(edges$type == "Co-authorship"), "co-author ·",
                  sum(edges$type == "Shared grant"), "grant")),
  stat_tile("Students with supervisors in both departments",
            paste0(round(100 * mean(cross_dept$both)), "%"),
            paste(sum(cross_dept$both), "of", nrow(cross_dept),
                  "students · SEEC supervisors only")),
  stat_tile("Clusters", length(setdiff(unique(nodes$community), "Smaller clusters")),
            "groups of people who often work together")
)
```

```{r}
htmltools::tags$script(
  type = "application/json", id = "network-data",
  htmltools::HTML(jsonlite::toJSON(payload, dataframe = "rows", na = "null", auto_unbox = TRUE))
)
```

## Most connected people

```{r}
seec_table(
  nodes %>%
    filter(role != "Other collaborator") %>%
    arrange(desc(links)) %>%
    transmute(Name = name, Role = as.character(role), Department = department,
              Cluster = community, Connections = links,
              `Students supervised` = n_students, Papers = n_papers, Grants = n_grants),
  id = "network-people",
  columns = list(Name = colDef(minWidth = 170), Cluster = colDef(minWidth = 190)),
  page_size = 15
)
```

::: chart-note
Names are matched across the sheets on surname and first initial (so "Altwegg R" and "Res Altwegg" are one person), with manual corrections in `data/name_aliases.csv`. Clusters are found automatically from who works with whom and are named after their best-connected member. People outside SEEC are co-supervisors and co-authors who are not in the SEEC team, student or alumni lists.
:::
